name: bleak-web
description: bleak-web — live event networking app on top of the bleak-node REST API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n helper,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @bleak/helper" "npm run dev -w @bleak/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bleak/api-client && npm run build -w @bleak/helper && npm run build -w @bleak/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bleak/api-client && npm run test -w @bleak/helper && npm run test -w @bleak/web
